These 3x3x3 scan fixtures are real per-sticker RGB readings taken from the
rubiks-color-resolver project by Daniel Walton, used under the MIT license.

  Repository: https://github.com/dwalton76/rubiks-color-resolver
  Commit:     c1a7211dd15a82589fc1454f630450ac26e5b44b (branch master)
  Source:     tests/test-data/3x3x3-*.txt
  Raw URL:    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dwalton76/rubiks-color-resolver/c1a7211dd15a82589fc1454f630450ac26e5b44b/tests/test-data/<file>

The files are copied unmodified. The expected answers used in
backend/tests/test_fixtures.py come from the same commit's tests/test-cubes.py.

Format: JSON object mapping square number "1".."54" to [R, G, B]. Faces are
numbered in the order U L F R B D, nine squares each, row-major in the
standard Kociemba orientation (upstream's cube_for_kociemba_strict() just
re-orders these blocks to U R F D L B without rotating any face).
